apiVersion: operator.config.grove.io/v1alpha1
kind: OperatorConfiguration
runtimeClientConnection:
  qps: 100
  burst: 150
leaderElection:
  enabled: true
  leaseDuration: 15s
  renewDeadline: 10s
  retryPeriod: 2s
  resourceLock: leases
  resourceName: grove-operator-leader-election
  resourceNamespace: dynamo
server:
  webhooks:
    port: 9443
    serverCertDir: /etc/grove-operator/webhook-certs
[REDACTED CONFIG LINE]
    certProvisionMode: auto
  healthProbes:
    port: 9444
  metrics:
    port: 9445
controllers:
  podCliqueSet:
    concurrentSyncs: 3
  podClique:
    concurrentSyncs: 3
  podCliqueScalingGroup:
    concurrentSyncs: 3

  profiles:
  - name: default-scheduler
  - name: kai-scheduler
debugging:
  enableProfiling: false
  pprofBindHost: "127.0.0.1"
  pprofBindPort: 2753

logFormat: json
